clm_11da2f3007.text: Dijkstra with a binary heap runs in O((V+E) log V) on graphs with non-negative weights.
clm_11da2f3007.notes: asymptotic result; says nothing about constant factors at the tested sizes

clm_2fdd1abb04.text: Bellman-Ford runs in O(V*E) and tolerates negative weights, which are not present in this benchmark.
clm_2fdd1abb04.notes: asymptotic result; says nothing about constant factors at the tested sizes

clm_8e37951c7d.text: Breadth-first search computes shortest paths only when every edge weight is equal.
clm_8e37951c7d.notes: asymptotic result; says nothing about constant factors at the tested sizes
